title: TNT Dome 8 Key
subtitle: The Emissary's Dome Access Card and Homer's secrets

sections.title: How to Start
sections.html:
There's no quest to start. You need the Dome Access Card from The Emissary, which in our testing only drops while the Invaders from Beyond event is on.

{img:tnt-dome-locations-map}

sections.title: TNT Dome 8 Key Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Find The Emissary

The Emissary is a random encounter that only appears at Scene encounter spots. The easiest route: fast travel to WV Lumber Co. in the Toxic Valley and run east along the road to Clancy Manor. If he isn't on one of the spots, wait 18 to 20 minutes for them to refresh, or server hop.

{img:dome-8-the-emissary}

Step 2 – Check the encounter spots

These are the spots along that road where he can appear.

{img:dome-8-emissary-route-wv-lumber-to-clancy-manor}

Step 3 – Or look further afield

He can also turn up at any of the other Scene spots on the map.

{img:dome-8-emissary-spawn-markers}

Step 4 – Talk to him first

Talk to him at least once before anything else: there's a small easter egg in what he says. Fun fact: in the game files, his encounter is called Man in Black.

{img:dome-8-emissary-easter-egg}

Step 5 – Get the Dome Access Card

The only way to get the Dome Access Card is to kill him. It isn't guaranteed: in our testing it was about a 50% chance, and only while the Invaders from Beyond event was on. One card gets you in once; to go back you need another.

{img:dome-8-dome-access-card}

sections.title: Finding the Dome
sections.html:
Step 6 – Go to Black Mountain Ordnance Works

Fast travel to Black Mountain Ordnance Works.

{img:dome-8-black-mountain-dome-8}

Step 7 – Walk to Dome 8

Run to the T-junction and turn left, keeping to the right-hand side of the road as it climbs. Go through the gap in the fence by the red This area is closed sign and straight on to the dirt road with a ruined building ahead-left. Turn left past the ruined building and the huge tree stump: the Dome 8 doors are at the end of the road.

{img:dome-8-dome-8-route}

Step 8 – Use the ID card reader

Swipe the Dome Access Card on the reader to the right of the entrance.

{img:dome-8-id-card-reader}

Step 9 – Check the screen

Interact with the screen for alien easter eggs and lore.

{img:dome-8-homer-screen}

Step 10 – Grab the holotape

The holotape The Truth is near the terminal.

{img:dome-8-the-truth-holotape}

sections.title: Rewards
sections.html:
• Homer's Aid: +5% damage against Zetans for 2 hours
  • Alien Blaster rounds (3), a laser pistol and laser ammo, a fusion core, a Hazmat Suit
  • Pork 'n Beans, Salisbury Steak, purified water, a doctor's bag and a medkit
{img:dome-8-homers-aid}

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Is it called the Mysterious Key?

In game it's the Dome Access Card.

Did Homer's Aid ever give Intelligence?

The game files have a +2 Intelligence effect set up for it, but the buff doesn't use it. You only get the damage bonus.

Does The Emissary turn up anywhere else?

There's also a Dead Mysterious Man encounter: his body, with aliens and an alien drone nearby.

Is this a quest?

No. There's no quest and nothing in your Pip-Boy tracks it: the keys, notes and codes are the trail.

What about domes 1, 4, 5 and 6?

Their doors can't be opened. Notes for domes 5 and 6 exist in the game files but aren't placed anywhere, so they look like unfinished content.

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
Black Mountain Ordnance Works is based on a real place, the West Virginia Ordnance Works. The records terminal in its main building (Cole & Parker Holdings LTD) has an entry for each dome; for domes 1, 4, 5 and 6 it only shows DATA READ ERROR.

Dome 8's entry has its owner, lease and payment all REDACTED.
